notes.title: 《DreamNight》Now on sale!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone! My first game 《DreamNight》 is officially released! [/p][p]It is a first-person horror puzzle game where you will play as an ordinary person living in an apartment, trying to escape this never-ending nightmare.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45488726/00e5a71256585b6c87abdb66f21dd20b2afd9036.png"][/img][/p][h2]About the Game[/h2][p]The inspiration for the game comes from the nightmares I've had, which are terrifying yet thought-provoking. In addition to puzzle-solving, elements like chase sequences and platform jumping have been added to enhance the gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45488726/f031bfe66e294179a5d67d99eed04fcb6c5d2aec.png"][/img][/p][h2]Archives and Strategies[/h2][p]1. The game has a single save file, but features a level loading function. The game will record the levels you have completed, and when you start a new game, you can find the levels on the left side of the initial room, starting from the left.[/p][p]2. If you get stuck in the game or want to restart, you can press the ‘’P‘’ key on the keyboard to commit suicide, and clicking restart will reset the current level.[/p][p]3. There is a jumping level in the game, and due to its difficulty, you can enable the ‘’F5‘’ key for temporary saving. (If you can complete the game using the default save, that's impressive!)[/p][p]4. All game strategies can be viewed in the group to avoid spoilers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45488726/94d35d450a787acaf62fa139bbf4f48d9a401dac.png"][/img][/p][h2]If you have any questions or suggestions for improvement, feel free to provide feedback. I will do my best to make the game better![/h2][p][/p]

notes.title: The game demo is free now! Let's experience the horror journey together!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is my first time making a game. I am responsible for the entire development of the game.

I like horror themes very much, and my favorite horror movie is "Hereditary"
My favorite horror game is "The Face", and my favorite horror comic is "The Vortex"
I am glad that I can develop a horror game by myself.

[h1]1. Demo is online![/h1]
"Nightmare" is a horror puzzle game with very simple operation. The scenes in it are all from my dreams.
If you are interested in my game, welcome to experience this exciting nightmare journey. The game demo is currently available for free trial.
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3503340/Nightmare/][/url]

[h1]2. Experience Feedback[/h1]
If you encounter any problems or need suggestions during the trial, please feel free to give us feedback. You can send us an email at 2243247594@qq.com or leave a message in the community.
With your help, the game will become better and better!
